driver.source:
"""Five private off-state Stop diagnostics, with finite phase labels only."""

import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
profile = root / "profile"
profile.mkdir(mode=0o700)
os.environ["HOME"] = str(profile)
for key in ("HOL_GUARD_HOME", "XDG_CONFIG_HOME", "XDG_DATA_HOME", "XDG_STATE_HOME", "XDG_CACHE_HOME", "CODEX_HOME"):
    os.environ.pop(key, None)
os.environ["HOL_GUARD_NATIVE_DIAGNOSTIC"] = "0"

from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.native_context_assistance import control
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.native_resident_client import close_native_residents

runtime = Path(os.environ["HOL_GUARD_NATIVE_BINARY"]).resolve(strict=True)
allowed = {"client_connect", "client_authenticate", "client_request_write", "client_response_read"}
pattern = re.compile(rb"native_resident_phase phase=([a-z_]+) status=(start|ok|error) elapsed_ms=([0-9]+)")
report = {
    "schema": "guard-cigar-native-stop-trace.v1",
    "qualification": "five fixed off-state diagnostics; helper phase logging only; not an SLO or relative benchmark",
    "cases": [],
    "completed": False,
}
try:
    for index in range(5):
        guard = root / f"guard-{index + 1}"
        guard.mkdir(mode=0o700)
        state = control("status", guard_home=guard)
        assert not state["requested_enabled"] and not state["effective_enabled"] and state["runtime"] is None
        row = {"case": index + 1, "requested_enabled": False}
        report["cases"].append(row)
        started = time.monotonic()
        try:
            environment = dict(os.environ, HOL_GUARD_NATIVE_DIAGNOSTIC="1")
            outcome = subprocess.run(
                [str(runtime), "resident-stop", "--state-dir", str(guard / "native-runtime")],
                capture_output=True, timeout=2, check=False, env=environment,
            )
            row.update({"process_outcome": "exited", "returncode": outcome.returncode})
            diagnostic = outcome.stderr
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
            row["process_outcome"] = "timed_out"
            diagnostic = error.stderr or b""
        finally:
            row["elapsed_ms"] = round((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000, 3)
            recovery_started = time.monotonic()
            row["recovery_contained"] = close_native_residents(guard, deadline_monotonic=recovery_started + 10)
            row["recovery_ms"] = round((time.monotonic() - recovery_started) * 1000, 3)
        assert len(diagnostic) <= 64 * 1024
        row["phases"] = []
        for line in diagnostic.splitlines():
            match = pattern.fullmatch(line)
            if match and match[1].decode() in allowed:
                row["phases"].append({"phase": match[1].decode(), "status": match[2].decode(), "elapsed_ms": int(match[3])})
        row["other_stderr_lines"] = len(diagnostic.splitlines()) - len(row["phases"])
        assert len(row["phases"]) <= 32 and row["recovery_contained"]
        print(json.dumps({k: row[k] for k in ("case", "process_outcome", "elapsed_ms", "recovery_contained")}), flush=True)
    report["completed"] = True
finally:
    # This process has used only the freshly created profile and five owned homes.
    report["process_owned_residents_contained"] = close_native_residents(deadline_monotonic=time.monotonic() + 10)
    report["CIGAR_imported"] = any(name == "cigar_sdk" or name.startswith("cigar_sdk.") for name in sys.modules)
    with (root / "result.json").open("x") as out:
        json.dump(report, out, indent=2)
        out.write("\n")

off_state_stop_trace.limits: Five off-state direct control/Stop cases all exit zero in 171 to 173 ms, without CIGAR import. Fixed helper phase labels only are persisted. This does not reproduce or resolve the daemon/activity Stop failures; it is not an SLO or relative benchmark.
